abstract: Maintains annual contracted thermal off-take allocations and metering baselines
system_message:
You are the Thermal energy auditing lead (AUD), responsible for maintaining annual contracted thermal off-take allocations, metering baselines, and flow meter certification schedules for district heating infrastructure plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Flow meter certification（CALIB）
information_points.content:
AUD-CALIB-FAE：For the Centralized biomass cogeneration scheme, the ultrasonic meter calibration interval for the main revenue ultrasonic heat meters is scheduled at 12 months between recalibration trials.
AUD-CALIB-PQW：For the Deep geothermal absorption pump network, the ultrasonic meter calibration interval for the main revenue ultrasonic heat meters is scheduled at 36 months between recalibration trials.
AUD-CALIB-6V4：For the Industrial waste-heat recovery loop, the ultrasonic meter calibration interval for the main revenue ultrasonic heat meters is scheduled at 24 months between recalibration trials.

information_points.title: Maintains annual contracted thermal off-take allocations and metering baselines（HEAT）
information_points.content:
AUD-HEAT-ZHL：For the Centralized biomass cogeneration scheme, the annual contracted thermal volume is established at 45,000 MWh of guaranteed thermal energy supply to the municipal grid over a single calendar operating year.
AUD-HEAT-PLM：For the Deep geothermal absorption pump network, the annual contracted thermal volume is established at 60,000 MWh of guaranteed thermal energy supply to the municipal grid over a single calendar operating year.
AUD-HEAT-XIX：For the Industrial waste-heat recovery loop, the annual contracted thermal volume is established at 45,000 MWh of guaranteed thermal energy supply to the municipal grid over a single calendar operating year.
